visualCharacteristics: Article hero with a full-width parallax image band, category label, large h1 title, lead paragraph and tags; light, dimmed, overlay and event-info layouts.
contentPattern: Rows: 1 hero picture (optional second mobile crop) | 2 category label | 3 h1 title | 4 lead paragraph | 5 tags paragraph or event info (optional CTA as last cell).
usage: Use as the opening hero of an article, research report or event page with image, category, title and lead.
reuseGuidance: Reuse at the top of editorial pages, keeping the row order and picking light, dim, overlay or event variants as needed.
